about: Tag-Team topics per level. mode relay = one team at the front, speakers take turns on one topic; mode debate = FOR team vs AGAINST team, speakers alternate. Times in seconds. M.2 and M.3 are the original sets; M.1 was written for Kru.

M.1.title: Talk
M.1.label: Topic
help: One team at the front. Huddle 0:30, then each speaker talks for 0:20. At the chime: TAG! The next speaker continues the same talk. The last speaker finishes it.
Challenge! The audience can challenge for: 3-second silence · repeating an idea · off topic · Thai. A fair challenge = +1 to the challenging team.
topics: A perfect day at the beach
The best animal in the world
What I do at the weekend
If I had a pet dragon
What I want to be in the future
Things I love about my town

M.2.title: Talk
M.2.label: Topic
help: One team at the front. Huddle 0:30, then each speaker talks for 0:25. At the chime: TAG! The next speaker continues the same talk. The last speaker finishes it.
Challenge! The audience can challenge for: 3-second silence · repeating an idea · off topic · Thai. A fair challenge = +1 to the challenging team.
topics: If our school had a robot teacher

M.3.title: Debate
M.3.label: Motion
help: Two teams at the front: FOR vs AGAINST. Huddle 1:30, then speakers take turns for 0:30 each, starting with FOR. Every speaker must answer the last point first ("I disagree because…").
Challenge! 3-second silence · repeating · off topic · Thai = +1 to the challenging team. The audience votes for the winning side: +3.
topics: Students should be allowed to use phones in class.
It's better to live in the city than the countryside.
Video games are good for teenagers.
Every student should learn to cook at school.
Social media does more harm than good.
Robots will make the world a better place.
Exams are the best way to test students.
Everyone should play a sport at school.
Fast food should not be sold near schools.
It's better to be famous than rich.
